newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE PRICES BY ONE CENT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE PRICES BY ONE CENT.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said it will cut its retail prices for gasolines in the Netherlands by one cent per litre with effect from August 29.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, the company said, adding the diesel price would remain unchanged.

From Thursday the price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations goes down to 2.04 guilders per litre. The price of premium leaded falls to 2.20 guilders and that of Euro regular unleaded to 1.99 guilders.
The recommended price for diesel goes remains unchanged at 1.42 guilders.
